audit.whatIsWrong: cassiopeia is she/her, but 3 field(s) in this matchup use he/him/his for her.
audit.why: The prose addresses the owner in second person, so third-person pronouns refer to the enemy. These templates were authored for a male enemy and only the champion name was substituted, leaving the pronouns wrong. champ-data/champ-gender.js is the authority.
